messages.text: Heads up: the overnight CreditScoring batch failed. Nightly model refresh job exited non-zero around 02:40 ET, so decision scores in LoanOrigination are still showing yesterday's run. Opening this as a SEV3 for now.
Thanks Angelica. Do we know the failure point yet? Is it the job itself or something upstream like DataLake?

Looking at logs now. The feature extraction step pulled from DataLake fine, but the scoring step threw a schema mismatch error on a new column. Looks like a partition got loaded with an extra field late last night.
Dropping in from Ops. Is this going to touch SettlementEngine at all? We have the morning clearing run at 9:30 and I just want to confirm nothing on our side depends on the scoring output.
No, CreditScoring only feeds LoanOrigination. SettlementEngine depends on OMS and GLCore, so you're clear. Same for PricingSvc, not involved here.
Perfect, thanks. Carry on with clearing as normal then.
Who owns the DataLake load that added the column? If it's a one-off we should patch the job. If it's permanent we need the schema contract updated and Lending told.

Traced it to a data engineering change that shipped yesterday afternoon, adding a bureau_flag field to the upstream table. It's meant to be permanent. Nobody updated the scoring job's expected schema.
OK. Impact is limited to loan applicants scored this morning getting stale scores, correct? Any in-flight decisions at risk?

Correct. Lending has a handful of applications queued that would normally use fresh scores. Nothing auto-approved on stale data, the origination workflow flags scores older than 24h for manual review. So it's slowdown, not bad decisions.
Good. Let's keep this SEV3 then. Angelica, please push the schema fix and rerun the batch. I'll let Brian Kowalski's team know to expect delayed scores until midday.
Fix is up for review: updated the expected schema to include the new column and made the loader tolerant of additive fields going forward so this class of change won't break the job again.
Reviewed and approved. Nice call on the additive tolerance. Go ahead and deploy and trigger a manual rerun.
Rerun kicked off at 9:35 ET and is running through feature extraction now. Expect about 40 minutes based on the usual duration.
Batch completed successfully at 10:20 ET. Spot checked scores in LoanOrigination, they're current and distributions look in line with yesterday's. Queued applications are now flowing.
Great, thanks. Marking this resolved. Please add a schema-change notification step to the DataLake release checklist so we hear about it before the batch does.
Will do. I'll file a ticket today and write up a short postmortem. Root cause: unannounced additive schema change plus a strict schema check in the scoring job. Fix is deployed.
Clearing ran fine on our end this morning. Thanks for the quick heads-up, both.
